artist.name: Lady Gaga
artist.profile:
Stefani Germanotta (born on March 28th, 1986 in New York), known by her stage name Lady Gaga, is an American singer, songwriter, composer, record producer, activist, businesswoman, fashion designer and actress.

Has worked as creative director at Polaroid.

Lady Gaga has a Mezzo-soprano vocal type.
Vocal range: 3.67 octaves (A2-F6).
